game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the druid must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the druid moves exactly n steps toward the heartwood tree.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the druid moves exactly n steps toward the heartwood tree. Each round, a new vine ropes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of vine ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Mossy Creek'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mossy Creek.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
